messages:
olivia: FYI starting staged rollout for model:mosaic-v2 to catalog during 2026-03-22 23:00-23:30 UTC change window. Goal: enable 50% traffic in Dedicated, 10% Hosted initially. Need deploybot consent + fallback ordering confirmed.
liam: ack. what's fallback order? mosaic-v1 -> mosaic-lite? or quantized variants?
maya: propose fallback ordering: mosaic-v2 (primary) -> mosaic-quant-v2 -> mosaic-v1. Reason: quant preserves latency/cost while matching quality.
diego: sounds fine but double-check model compatibility tag — some clients pinned to mosaic-v1 by version pinning flag.
olivia: good catch. We'll add a temporary pinlist for customers with pin=prod-mosaic, exclude them from traffic shift.
ops_lead: please add release notes for public API (behavioral change summary) and flag known regressions.
olivia: will add short blurb to release notes. also ops: need rollout monitor thresholds: latency + error rate + quality delta. Propose SLO gate: 99th latency < 350ms, error rate delta < 0.5%, qualitative eval regression < 1%.
liam: agree. can we add automatic rollback on sustained 3min breach of any gate?
maya: we have deploybot hook for that. deploybot: please confirm hooks.
deploybot: @channel deploybot scheduled mosaic-v2 enable at 2026-03-22T23:00:00Z. Prechecks: model-compat, telemetry hooks, pinlist applied. Auto-rollback configured on gate breaches for 3m. Reaction needed: :white_check_mark: to proceed.
diego: :white_check_mark: 
liam: :white_check_mark:
olivia: :white_check_mark: adding note: will run small canary (2 nodes) for first 10 mins then ramp.
sre-bot: metric alert pages configured: mosaic-rollout-latency, mosaic-rollout-errors, model-quality-regression. Pager threshold set to 5% latency increase sustained 10m.
ops_lead: changewindow approved. please ensure release notes link in the rollout thread and contact list for oncall.
olivia: release notes added: https://internal.redwood/release-notes/mosaic-v2. Contact list: @liam, @maya, @diego, @ops_lead, @olivia.
maya: quick question: if deploybot triggers rollback to mosaic-quant-v2, do we also re-pin traffic to legacy mosaic-v1 for EU region? we need region-specific fallback ordering.
liam: regional mapping: EU -> fallback to mosaic-v1 first (regulatory perf), US -> mosaic-quant-v2. We'll document in fallback map.
olivia: updated fallback map in ops doc. snippet: region_fallback = { 'EU': ['mosaic-v1','mosaic-quant-v2'], 'US': ['mosaic-quant-v2','mosaic-v1'] }
diego: paste the actual config please.
olivia: ```yaml
catalog:
  model_entries:
    - id: mosaic-v2
      fallback_order:
        - mosaic-quant-v2
        - mosaic-v1
    - id: mosaic-quant-v2
      fallback_order:
        - mosaic-v1
```
liam: question on version pinning: customers with pin=prod-mosaic will be in exclude_list. Who maintains that list?
ops_lead: support owns pinlist updates. @support please confirm you can freeze pins through window.
deploybot: confirm pinlist: support-pinned: 12 customers currently. Excluding them from traffic shift.
support: confirmed, we'll monitor pins and hold any auto shifts for pinned customers.
maya: test plan: create 5 synthetic prompts, run quality eval against baseline, publish results to telemetry channel.
olivia: schedule: 23:00 canary (2 nodes, 10mins), 23:10 ramp to 50% dedicated, 23:20 evaluate telemetry, 23:25 decide ramp to 100% dedicated or rollback. Hosted ramp later in next window.
liam: logging checklist: ensure token-level cost metrics and kv-cache hit rate are captured.
sre-bot: kv-cache and token-cost metrics included.
diego: minor nit: make sure to set fallback TTL to 15s to avoid oscillations under short spikes.
olivia: set fallback_ttl=15s in config prior to enabling.
deploybot: executing prechecks now... model-compat: OK, telemetry-hook: OK, pinlist applied: OK, fallback_order configured: OK, fallback_ttl: 15s set. Ready to enable. Waiting for final ack to proceed.
liam: go for it.
maya: go.
olivia: enabling now.
deploybot: mosaic-v2 enable step1: canary started (2 nodes). Canary traffic = 5% of test traffic, 0.5% global. Start time 2026-03-22T23:00:15Z.
olivia: monitoring..
olivia: observed 99p latency 320ms, error rate 0.1%, quality delta -0.2% — within gates.
liam: looks healthy. continue ramp after 10m.
deploybot: ramping to 50% dedicated at 2026-03-22T23:10:30Z.
diego: post-ramp check: 99p latency 345ms, error rate 0.2%, quality delta -0.6%
maya: quality delta approaching threshold but still under 1%.
ops_lead: keep an eye; set manual hold if anything trends worse.
olivia: holding at 50% to gather 10m of data.
olivia: after 10m: latency stable, quality delta -0.7% — still acceptable. Decision: proceed to full dedicated roll later tonight.
liam: note for release notes: behavior change: slightly different tokenization in mosaic-v2 causing minor length diffs.
olivia: noted.
deploybot: operation complete for tonight. Final state: mosaic-v2 active at 50% dedicated, fallback map in place, auto-rollback hooks enabled. Closing thread; escalation contacts listed.
olivia: thanks everyone. will file post-rollout short report.
